result.summary: Vodafone Idea currently has one open overdue invoice (INR 9.0M, due 2026-11-05, now 18 days past due) against policy TCI-SCF-2026-0001, which carries a INR 120M limit (total exposure ~40M, so utilization remains moderate). However, the pattern across the last three notifications shows lengthening resolution times (5 days late → 9 days late → currently 18 days and still open), all from the same single policy, with notification frequency also ticking up (2 in the last 6 months vs 1 in the prior window).
concerns: Days-to-resolve overdue invoices has been steadily increasing (5 → 9 → 18+ days), signalling slowing payment behaviour
All overdue notifications originate from a single policy (TCI-SCF-2026-0001), limiting visibility into broader payment conduct
Slight uptick in notification frequency within the 180-day window (1 → 2) could indicate early-stage accumulation if it continues
Current open overdue is unresolved and already exceeds the days-late of both prior resolved cases
